items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Wendell Jackson was playing the other trombone.

ctx.x: I didn't name the trumpet players, though. Jeff -- Warren Jefferson. Leon Hill was playing trumpet. That was all the trumpets. Wendell Jackson was playing the other trombone. That was it.
Who was in the band when you were there? And what was the band into? What kind of stuff did they play?
